findings.title: Pass a user record when deleting from the association
findings.body: `group.users.delete` expects associated user records, but this passes an integer ID. ActiveRecord may treat the integer as a record and call methods such as `id` on it, causing the removal request to fail or target the wrong ID. Look up the user or delete the join row by `user_id` explicitly; otherwise admins cannot reliably remove group members.

findings.title: Exact page-size membership counts produce an extra page
findings.body: This formula adds a page even when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (for example, 50 members at a limit of 50 yields two pages). The Next action then requests offset 50 and displays an empty page. Use a ceiling calculation so exact multiples have no phantom final page.

findings.title: Public group member pages now omit members beyond the first 50
findings.body: This applies a 50-row limit to every group, whereas previously non-automatic groups returned all members. The public members template renders the returned list without pagination controls, so groups with more than 50 members silently appear incomplete. Preserve the uncapped behavior for that page or add public pagination.
